{{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Dino.png|thumb|250px|Dino]] '''Dino''' (Japanese: '''ディーノ''' ''Dino'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. ==History== Dino debuted in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', where he participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament. His first opponent was {{OBP|Omega|BW039}}, who used a {{p|Patrat}}. Dino managed to defeat Omega using his {{p|Deerling}} which advanced him to the second round. In ''[[BW041|The Club Battle Hearts of Fury: Emolga Versus Sawk!]]'', he was paired with [[Antonio]] as his opponent in the second round. As Antonio chose to use {{p|Cottonee}} against {{p|Tranquill}}, Dino had no trouble battling him as he managed to defeat Antonio, moving on to the semi-final round. His opponent in that round was {{Ash}} where he chose {{p|Darumaka}} to go up against [[Ash's Palpitoad]]. Their battle took place in [[BW042|the next episode]], where his Darumaka was defeated by a single {{m|Hydro Pump}} from Ash's Palpitoad. As a result, Dino ended up getting eliminated from the tournament. In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Dino competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, meaning he had made it through the first round. In ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', he appeared once again on the screen of the Vertress Conference, now showing the match-ups for the last sixteen, meaning he had made it through the second and third rounds. In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', it was revealed that he had made it through the fourth round as well. In the quarterfinals, he battled [[Katharine]] and won in ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]''. In the semifinals, he was paired against [[Ramone]] and defeated him, thus advancing to the finals. There, he lost to [[Virgil]], becoming the runner-up of the Vertress Conference.
